en.name: Emmanuel Berrio Jimenez
en.title: FullStack Software Developer
en.summary: Fullstack programmer with more than 4 years of experience, dedicated to transforming ideas into fluid and memorable web experiences. I master technologies such as HTML, CSS, Sass, React.js, Vue.js and Angular, as well as backend development in C#, ASP.NET, PHP and Node.js. I work with MySQL and PostgreSQL, and handle Git fluently. With initiative, fast learning and a vision always open to innovation, I bring dynamism and technical clarity to excel in demanding development environments.

references.name: Tatiana Díaz
